Problems this solves

When listing images lack a strategy, shoppers have to work too hard.

  • The main image does not distinguish the product in search results.
  • Infographics combine too many messages without hierarchy.
  • Benefits become difficult to read on mobile.
  • The sequence leaves important objections unanswered.

Decoration vs. strategy

An attractive image is not always a useful image.

FAQ

Questions about this service

How many listing images should I create?

It depends on the product and category. The sequence should cover benefits, use, dimensions, differentiation and objections without adding images that have no clear purpose.

Can the main image contain text?

As a general rule, it must show the actual product on a pure white background and should not contain text, borders, watermarks or accessories that are not included. Category rules may add requirements.

Is image copy included?

Yes. We organize headlines, benefits and concise supporting text so every image remains clear and easy to scan.

Do you guarantee a higher CTR?

No percentage can be guaranteed. Visual design can improve clarity and differentiation, but CTR also depends on pricing, reviews, ranking, advertising and competition.
